Oncall-Bot: INCIDENT alert — elevated 5xx rate observed in serving-east-1 at ~09:11 UTC, spike sustained 4m. Auto-mitigation lowered concurrency for canaries.
DeployBot: Scheduled release 2026-03-20T09:30 UTC (version 1.13.0-canary) targeting canary -> gradual rollout. Job id: rbld-20260320-09
Nate: Heads-up — we should hold the rollout. 5xx spike overlaps with canary window. Can someone pin the release and stop the canary? @DeployBot
DeployBot: Received: cancel canary for job rbld-20260320-09. Action: stopping canary, preserving artifacts. Cmd: `/deploy cancel rbld-20260320-09 --reason "incident hold"`
Claire: Confirmed. Hold in place. Pining target version to 1.12.9 for immediate fallback. Claire pinned version -> 1.12.9 in release registry :white_check_mark:
Maya: Ops note — the spike looks correlated with KV cache eviction churn after yesterday's kernel bump. Investigating host-level logs now. If kernel rollback is feasible we can avoid app rollback.
Carlos: If we do app rollback we should keep the DB migration flag off. Current release includes optional schema-toggle `schema_opt_in` — do NOT enable if we rollback.
Tina: Rolling back canary now would be low impact. Recommend: 1) stop canary (done), 2) do not rollback full service yet, 3) run extended canary on pinned 1.12.9 in a small slice (5%) while ENG-ML checks latency tail, 4) set change window for reschedule.
Nate: Plan agreed. I'll open a release window proposal: reschedule full rollout to 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC, staircase 5/20/50/100, manual gate between steps. Ops will validate 5% for 30m before proceeding. Any objections?
Claire: No objections. Add rollback decision tree to the release notes and call out KV eviction metric thresholds. Also add `--force-ro` flag procedure for quick isolate if we see write latencies.
Maya: Will attach current host logs and a short root-cause hypothesis to incident ticket. I'll add thresholds: 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 10m -> abort.
Nate: OK. I'll update the release docs and change window. Draft checklist:

```
- Hold active (done)
- Canary stopped (DeployBot done)
- Version pinned -> 1.12.9 (Claire)
- Ops investigation in progress (Maya)
- Reschedule to 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC, staircase 5/20/50/100
- Manual gate between steps, 30m validation on 5% and 20%
- Rollback decision tree & KV eviction thresholds added to notes
- Communication: email to customers in affected regions if reschedule impacts SLA
```
Tina: I'll be on the 02:00 UTC shift and will own the manual gate. Adding me to the runbook. :thumbsup:
Nate: Thanks — I'll update the release ticket and ping infra when the reschedule is published. Closing this thread for further action items in the ticket. :lock:
